chapter: Technique and life on the road (repeated passages)
title: Rex Stewart, Earl Hines and who gets remembered
summary: He wonders why no one mentions Rex Stewart, a great trumpet player, and they discuss how leaders get remembered.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: They had Rex in the band. No one ever says anything about Rex! I wonder why. Rex was a great trumpet player.
You know who talks about him always? Roy. Roy would always mention Rex. Even if he sometimes talks...sometimes talks about how he finally got to him. He says Rex upset him, you know, at first...
...with his speed. But I guess maybe one of the reasons why some musicians or people don't talk about him is that he was a leader for a long time, and maybe some people feel that he got a...
Well, Earl Hines was a leader, and he still is thought of great.
What are you gonna do with that? But he's still living, though...however.
Yes. And of course, he's such a great soloist, and he's been established...
Rex will be remembered, though, because people will always be reading what he wrote, those books, and then they'll check him out, how he played, so I think...
And he recorded a considerable amount.
